name: stick lat stretch
description: A standing stretch that uses a stick to pull the arm overhead and open up the side of your back. Good for tight lats and overhead mobility.
instructions: Stand tall and grip the stick with both hands, one end held high.
Reach the stick overhead and lean gently away from the higher hand.
Keep your hips square and your ribs from flaring out.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along your side and back.
Return to upright and switch sides.
